title: Only An Excuse for a Scottish Mod
description: A simple mod that adds a few bits and pieces of Scotland into Minecraft. Food, drink, plant life, even a little music!
body:
This very simple mod adds a few iconic items from iconic country Scotland! From famous foods to popular plants, this mod lets you include a bit of highland flavour to your minecraft world. Some items can be found through a wandering trader and some can be crafted just from regular vanilla items like potatoes.

This mod is a loving passion project to the home country of its developer filled with silly references and fun items. I hope you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it.
